title: Red Skelton Collector Plate 1982 Bronco Freddie #824 of 15,000 Armstrong
descriptionText:
Red Skelton "Bronco Freddie" collector plate, #824 of 15,000, the 2nd plate in the "Freddie's Adventures" series. Created from an original work of art by Red Skelton, produced by Armstrong's (Crown Parian), 1982. Porcelain, approx. 8.5" diameter.
Condition: excellent — no chips, cracks, or crazing noted. Not intended for food use (decorative display plate). Ships well-packed.
